The decisive mistake was made by **VideoContentAnalysis_Expert** at **step 5**. It told the Computer_terminal to run `from functions import get_youtube_caption`, a helper it had not verified existed, and it did so after already downloading the video with `yt-dlp` without requesting subtitles. The failure that followed (`You are not subscribed to this API`) ended the caption route. The agent then moved to an audio-extraction plan with no working speech-to-text step, and its later `pip install ffmpeg` was the wrong package. Using `yt-dlp --write-auto-subs --sub-langs en --skip-download` would likely have retrieved the transcript directly.
